description: Latest new token launches on Base, up to 20, each with our automated contract-risk check at request time (Sourcify verification, upgradeable proxy, owner type, mint/pause/blacklist/fee selectors; B20 native tokens are labeled as not checkable by bytecode), plus pool DEX, age, liquidity, FDV and 1h buys/sells. Source: GeckoTerminal's public new-pools feed (newest first, one row per new token), checked live at request time. Heuristics, not an audit. Costs $0.01.
name: base_launch_feed
